task_text: Cylinder rescue, guide route and oriented delivery: A short round-ended cylinder is rolling along a raised lane when the episode starts and will run off its end. Intercept it in the open-sided tray the Panda holds. Bring it to rest in the tray with its long axis along the world's y axis. Put it into a gently sloping guide channel near the channel's entry, and let it travel out past the far end without the tray touching it at that moment. Catch it again in the tray at the exit, aligned and settled. Finally, deliver it lying along y into a pocket that slides back and forth on a rail, where it must rest while the pocket is moving. Phases, in order: rolling_interception: The cylinder is held by the tray and does not touch the source lane. 'Held' means: in contact with the tray within the last 25 ms; in the tray frame its centre has |x| and |y| < `tool_half` = 0.07 m; and its centre is between 0.013 m and 0.07 m above the tray floor.; axial_alignment: The cylinder is held (as above) and aligned, moving at less than 0.06 m/s relative to the tray (at its centre), for 0.3 s without interruption. Aligned means its long axis is within 0.2 rad of the world y axis, either way round: |y component of the axis| > cos 0.2.; guide_rail_traverse: During this phase the cylinder touches the guide while its centre is at world x < 0.02. Later, at a step when it does not touch the tray, its centre is at world x > 0.24, past the guide's exit end.; exit_reception: The cylinder is held by the tray (as above), aligned with world y within 0.2 rad, not touching the guide, and moving at less than 0.06 m/s relative to the tray, for 0.2 s without interruption.; oriented_moving_delivery: All of the following hold for 0.7 s without interruption. The cylinder touches the pocket and is not held by the tray. It lies inside the pocket: in the pocket's frame, for both x and y, |centre offset| + 0.019 + 0.019 x |axis component| < 0.075, i.e. the whole capsule is inside the inner walls. Its centre is more than 0.016 m above the pocket floor, and its top (centre height + 0.019 + 0.019 x |axis z component|) is below 0.063 m. Its long axis is within 0.2 rad of world y. The pocket moves faster than 0.02 m/s. The cylinder moves at less than 0.06 m/s relative to the pocket. This completes the task. Goal geometry: Required orientation: the cylinder's long axis along world y (either sign) within 0.2 rad. Guide test lines: world x = 0.02 (entry contact must occur at x below it) and world x = 0.24 (exit beyond it).
